items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: I saw him last in New York so many years ago... His song is in the same house where I song

ctx.x: Yeah, well, if you check in tonight, if you're in the neighborhood, go across the street and ask for Joe.
He's an old man, too. Oh, yeah, Joe.
But he talks about you, you know, and the different guys and all that.
